evidence_text:
Comparison brief: Heliox Pressure Sensor vs Quarryline Pressure Sensor
evidence_dose=-2 (positive ⇒ more points favour Heliox Pressure Sensor)

- p1: sensor accuracy (% FS): Heliox Pressure Sensor=99.1  | Quarryline Pressure Sensor=99.4 ← better
- p2: unit cost ($): Heliox Pressure Sensor=18.5  | Quarryline Pressure Sensor=15.0 ← better
- p3: MTBF (hours): Heliox Pressure Sensor=41000  | Quarryline Pressure Sensor=48000 ← better
- p4: calibration drift / year: Heliox Pressure Sensor=0.8  | Quarryline Pressure Sensor=0.5 ← better
- p5: IP rating: Heliox Pressure Sensor=IP67 ← better | Quarryline Pressure Sensor=IP65
- p6: lead time (days): Heliox Pressure Sensor=21  | Quarryline Pressure Sensor=14 ← better
- p7: temp range (°C span): Heliox Pressure Sensor=140 ← better | Quarryline Pressure Sensor=120
- p8: firmware update downtime (min): Heliox Pressure Sensor=8  | Quarryline Pressure Sensor=5 ← better

Tally: Heliox Pressure Sensor better on 2/8; Quarryline Pressure Sensor better on 6/8.
